title: SI Envelope (v0.1)
description: Common signed message structure for SI Edge communication (SIE-COM section A5). Every message except F5 advertisements (SIE-COM section A3) and F7 media frames after stream setup (SIE-COM section A4) uses it. Requested actions go in instructions; content goes in data, which is always untrusted and never grants authority (SIE-COM section A5, A7). Receivers MUST reject envelopes that are unsigned, expired, replayed, not addressed to them (aud), out of sequence beyond the configured window, or of an unknown major version; this schema checks structure only, and freshness, replay, and signature checks are the receiver's job. Unknown members are rejected (fail closed). Status: Draft, not for implementation.

form.description: Communication form (SIE-COM section A1). F5 is excluded because discovery advertisements are not envelopes; the form of an advertisement is recorded in the advertisement itself.

aud.description: Intended recipient: agent, device, or provider identity. A single recipient (conservative choice, schemas/OPEN-QUESTIONS.md).

seq.description: Sequence number within the session (SIE-COM section A9).

attestation_ref.description: Reference to the device's attestation or profile claim. Required at C3; otherwise null. The member is always present (conservative reading of 'may be empty').

cap_token.description: Capability token authorising this message (SIE-COM section A6). Required on every envelope except pairing messages (intent in the reserved si.pairing namespace). Either an SI capability token, or another attenuable token format wrapped with its format name.

format.description: Registered name of an attenuable token format.

intent.description: Declared purpose from a registered vocabulary (vocabulary not yet defined, SIE-COM section D Q1). Lowercase dotted name. The si.pairing.* namespace is reserved for pairing messages (SIE-COM section A3) and si.refused for refusals (SIE-COM section A7).

instructions.description: Requested action, structured, signed by the sender. Covered by the envelope signature (sig), which is made with the sending agent's key. Present when an action is requested.

consequential.description: Sender's declaration that the action is consequential (SIE-RT section 1). The receiver decides independently; a false value never skips approval.

data.description: Payload content. Always untrusted data. The receiving Core MUST NOT grant authority based on anything inside data (SIE-COM section A5).

payload_type.description: Media type (RFC 6838) or schema URI of data. Required when data is present.

residency.description: Residency tags (SIE-RT section 11) and data classes of the content. Multiple tags are combined by intersection (most restrictive), see schemas/OPEN-QUESTIONS.md. An empty tags list means the owner set no residency restriction for this content.

idem_key.description: Idempotency key; receivers execute each idem_key at most once (SIE-COM section A9). Required for state-changing messages; this schema requires it whenever instructions are present (conservative choice).

expires.description: Expiry; store-and-forward queues MUST respect it (SIE-COM section A9). Must be later than issued (checked by tools/validate).

provenance.description: Chain of prior senders, delegations, and proxies (F6, F8, SIE-COM section B5), oldest first. Empty if there is no prior hop.

model_ref.description: Which agent and model produced the content (SIE-COM section A5, A10; SIE-RT section 14). Required when a model produced content.

sig.description: Signature by the sending agent key over the canonical form of the envelope without sig.

role.description: origin: an earlier sender whose message is being forwarded. delegator: a runtime that delegated the task (F6). proxy: a runtime translating for a legacy endpoint (Method 4). relay / store-and-forward: infrastructure (F8, F9). legacy-endpoint: the legacy endpoint behind a proxy or adapter.

method.description: Legacy compatibility method used at this hop (SIE-COM Part B).

allOf.description: SIE-COM section B1, B5: every legacy endpoint is labelled legacy and unattested in the envelope.

provider.description: Provider identity, or absent for local inference.

region.description: Region where the model ran (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code or provider region name).

weights_digest.description: Hash of the model weights for local models (SIE-RT section 3).
